why: Terra mills two each combat and, when she hits a player, pays two to return a creature with power 3 or less, so the deck wants small creatures whose value is on entering or dying (every hit replays removal, draw or another reanimation), more ways to bring creatures back, extra combats, and ways to put the right creature in the graveyard. Creatures with power over 3 are off-theme: she can't return them. Approved by the user Nov 23, 2026, from four options (sacrifice loop, Final Fantasy legends and extra combats were the others).
